records.text: The Daily Mail's anonymous source said Candace Owens had made the Charlie Kirk case her identity as a grab for attention, brand growth, and money, and said that was Erika Kirk's view.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep OgRyiOAVtWU)

appearances.snippet: That bridge is burned between Erika (Erika Kirk) and Candace. It's more than burned. It's been blown up. There's no reason for Erika (Erika Kirk) to ever speak to Candace again, ever, the family member said. ... Candace decided to make this her identity. It's a grab for attention, building her name and her brand and making some money off of it. ... That's what Erika (Erika Kirk) thinks.

verification.notes: The primary episode records Owens reading the Daily Mail passage attributing the attention, brand, and money accusation to a Kirk family member and describing it as Erika Kirk's view. A current episode summary independently describes the same report. This verifies publication of the accusation, not its truth or the anonymous source's access.
